title: A cleaner home header
details: The large Target card has been removed and the compact bullseye Target control is back in the top-right
The Target control still opens the same full target board as before
The course identity on the left is now reduced to two short lines: course name and course code
Bricklayer shows Bricklayer / ST0095, Trowel shows Trowel / 6570-05, and Carpentry or Joinery show their course name / ST0264
summary: The home header is smaller and clearer, with the original compact target control restored.
changes: Restored the compact bullseye Target shortcut
Simplified the course title to two small lines
Refreshed the offline shell to v110
